description: A four-panel composite figure (TEM-based imaging plus crystallographic orientation mapping) showing microstructure evolution in a Fe–30Mn–6.5Al–0.3C (wt.%) low-density steel after tensile deformation. (a) is a TEM micrograph with a 2 µm scale bar showing intersecting planar bands labelled TW, MB1, MB2 and MB3 (microbands), with an inset unit stereographic triangle whose corners are marked 001, 101 and 111. (b) is a colour-coded orientation map of the same field, same 2 µm scale bar and the same TW/MB1/MB2/MB3 labels, with a red stereographic-triangle inset. (c) is a lower-magnification orientation map (5 µm scale bar) resolving two grains: G1, red-dominant and annotated "DDWs + MBs", and G2, blue, containing twins labelled TW1 and TW2; a 001/101/111 colour triangle is the orientation legend. (d) maps the same field as a colour-scaled misorientation/quality map (5 µm scale bar), with arrows pointing to the "DDWs + MBs" band structure in G1 and a colour bar labelled Min 0, Max 2.5 (no unit printed). The panels together argue that dense dislocation walls/microbands in austenite coexist with deformation twins, and that microband-containing grains are unfavourable for twin formation — the heterogeneous deformation structure behind the enhanced work hardening.
measured_quantities: colour-scale range 0–2.5 (unit not printed, panel d)

observations.observation: Panel (a) is a TEM micrograph with a 2 µm scale bar showing intersecting planar deformation bands annotated TW, MB1, MB2 and MB3.
Panel (a) contains an inset unit stereographic triangle whose corners are labelled 001, 101 and 111.
Panel (b) is a colour-coded orientation map of the same field as (a) with a 2 µm scale bar and the identical TW/MB1/MB2/MB3 labels, plus a red stereographic-triangle inset.
Panel (c) is an orientation map with a 5 µm scale bar in which the red grain G1 is annotated 'DDWs + MBs' and the blue grain G2 contains features labelled TW1 and TW2.
Panel (c) includes a 001/101/111 colour-coded stereographic triangle as the orientation legend.
Panel (d) covers the same field as (c) with a 5 µm scale bar; multiple arrows point to the band structure annotated 'DDWs + MBs' in G1, and TW1/TW2 lie within the grain labelled G2.
Panel (d) carries a colour bar labelled Min 0 and Max 2.5 with no unit printed.
The caption states the figure shows microstructure evolution in Fe–30Mn–6.5Al–0.3C (wt.%) low-density steel during tensile deformation at 196 C.
The citing text states the tensile deformation was performed at −196 °C, which disagrees with the caption's printed '196 C'; the image itself cannot resolve which is correct.
The citing text states that under low strain the intense movement of closely spaced slip bands activated planar slip localization and finally formed the microbands seen in Fig. 14a and b.
The citing text states that at high strain new microbands formed together with the generation of deformation twins (Fig. 14a and b).
The citing text states that microbands located within austenite grains were not conducive to the formation of deformation twins (Fig. 14c and d).
The citing text attributes the enhanced work hardening and mechanical properties at cryogenic temperature to this complex, highly uneven deformation structure.

subfigures.description: TEM micrograph with a 2 µm scale bar showing intersecting planar deformation bands labelled TW (twin) and MB1, MB2, MB3 (microbands) in a heavily dislocated matrix; an inset unit stereographic triangle is labelled 001, 101, 111 at its corners.

Colour-coded crystallographic orientation map of the same field as (a), 2 µm scale bar, carrying the identical TW/MB1/MB2/MB3 annotations and a red stereographic-triangle inset; the bands appear in distinct colour contrast against the matrix.

Orientation map with a 5 µm scale bar covering two grains: the large red grain G1 annotated 'DDWs + MBs' and the blue grain G2 containing features labelled TW1 and TW2; a 001/101/111 colour-coded stereographic triangle is given as the orientation key.

Orientation/intensity map of the same two-grain field as (c), 5 µm scale bar; several arrows point toward the 'DDWs + MBs' band structure in G1, while TW1 and TW2 lie in the blue grain G2; a colour bar is labelled Min 0 and Max 2.5 without a printed unit.
